name: Pony V6 XL Full Score Tag Stack
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: For Pony Diffusion V6 XL, open positive prompts strictly with `score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, score_6_up, score_5_up, score_4_up` and mirror lower tiers (`score_6, score_5, score_4`) in negatives to keep sharpness maximal without degrading composition.

name: Pony XL Anti-Anime Photorealism Lock
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Override Pony V6 XL's illustration prior explicitly: pair `source_fotography, photo (medium), RAW photo, DSLR` at front of positive prompt with `source_anime, anime, cartoon, illustration, painting, 3d render, cgi` suppressed in negative.
negative_prompt_patch: source_anime, cartoon, illustration, painting, sketch, 3d render, cgi, plastic skin

name: SDXL Low-CFG Natural Dynamic Range
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: On `sd-server` SDXL/Pony, hold CFG tightly between `5.0` and `6.8` with `24–30` steps (`dpmpp_2m` or `euler`); never push CFG >= 8.0 or highlights clip harsh and skin turns waxy orange.

name: CLIP Skip -2 Semantic Precision
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Pony V6 XL relies on penultimate CLIP hidden layer conditioning (`CLIP Skip 2`). Order visual concepts concretely—Subject + Pose -> Wardrobe Material -> Lighting Source -> Camera Glass -> Surface Texture—never burying lens tokens at the very tail.

name: SDXL Native Resolution Aspect Lock
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor SDXL generation cleanly inside native pixel area buckets (`1024×1024`, `1216×832` landscape, `832×1216` portrait, `1152×896`) matching subject orientation so tall bodies never squash or duplicate.

name: Natural Skin Pores & Subsurface Texture
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Request authentic organic epidermis: `visible fine skin pores, subtle peach fuzz catching backlight, faint natural skin unevenness, micro-wrinkles around eye corners, translucent ear cartilage scatter`, avoiding doll smoothness.
negative_prompt_patch: airbrushed skin, porcelain skin, smooth plastic skin, waxy face

name: Iris Fibers & Moist Corneal Catchlight
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Give every portrait unmistakable ocular life: `sharp detailed fibrous iris ring, clean window-shaped catchlight reflecting off moist cornea, natural sclera blood vessel hint, distinct upper/lower eyelashes`.
negative_prompt_patch: dead eyes, asymmetrical pupils, cross-eyed, blank sclera

name: Hand Physics & Natural Prop Grip
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Avoid idle open-palm poses facing lens: give hands concrete physical contact (`fingers wrapped gently around ceramic espresso cup`, `hands tucked naturally inside wool coat pockets`, `grip centered cleanly on strap`) with relaxed knuckles.

name: Stray Flyaway Strands & Hair Parting
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Avoid helmet-like solid hair clumps by specifying `individual translucent stray flyaway hair strands glowing softly against backlight, natural irregular scalp parting, subtle wind lift across temple`.

name: Minimal Non-Flattening Negative Filter
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep negatives light and structural so shadows retain velvet depth—exclude generic style-killers (`darkness, contrast, noise`) and filter only anatomical/rendering failure tags cleanly.

name: Two-Subject Attribute Separation
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep dual-subject prompts strictly separated spatially (`2people, tall man on left in charcoal wool overcoat, woman on right in burnt orange scarf sitting at café table`) so outfit colors and hair never bleed between faces.

name: Balanced Token Emphasis Restraint
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep any Pony emphasis weights restrained between `(token:1.1)` and `(token:1.25)`; aggressive weights `>= 1.4` introduce rainbow chromatic ringing and high-frequency grain tearing.

name: Optical Bokeh & Distance Calibration
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Match aperture to subject distance realistically: use `85mm f/1.4, subject sharp eyelashes forward fading into creamy circular night bokeh orbs`, avoiding artificial Photoshop edge halos.

name: Soft Film Highlight Roll-Off
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Prevent cheap clipped digital whites around sunlit windows or sky clouds via `gentle creamy photographic highlight roll-off, subtle halation glow, clean midtone contrast, zero aggressive HDR`.

name: Seamless Full-Frame Detail Integrity
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe continuous fine fabric seams, wood grain boards, and atmospheric gradients sweeping smoothly edge-to-edge cleanly without checkerboard patching or flat smudge zones.

name: Unposed Candid Posture Geometry
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Break stiff symmetry completely: capture mid-blink laugh lines, weight leaning unevenly onto one hip, jacket collar turned asymmetrically, gaze fixed off-camera toward street motion.

name: Authentic High-ISO Film Grain Structure
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Replace synthetic glossy surfaces with `subtle fine organic 400-ISO silver halide grain balanced cleanly inside shadow regions`, uniting foreground actors with painted architectural walls.

name: Realistic Sweat, Rain & Moisture Speculars
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Model moisture physics truthfully: hairline damp clumping, tiny specular micro-beads gleaming under key rimlight along collarbone/glass, darkened wet cotton collar patches.

name: Color-Bleed Prevention Across Props
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Place colors right next to their owning noun with distinct contrasting anchors (`ivory ceramic cup on dark slate counter beside emerald glass bottle`) so colors stay compartmentalized.

name: Mirror & Water Symmetry Coherence
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify matching horizon alignment and gentle optical ripples (`calm dark lake reflecting exact inverted amber ridge peaks with subtle breeze distortion`) for coherent mirror reflections.

name: Real-World Wear, Scuffs & Dust Grounding
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Ban sterile CGI cleanliness: add faint heel scuffs on floorboards, coffee cup ring on oak bar, chipped edge enamel, finger smudges along brass doorknob, and dust in molding corners.

name: Zone-System B&W Contrast Discipline
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Structure grayscale photography cleanly across true black crevices (Zone II), textured midtone granite/linen (Zone V), and bright crisp cloud edges (Zone VIII) without muddy gray wash.

name: High-Key Snow & White Porcelain Preservation
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep bright white subjects (`snowdrifts, white linen shirt, frost`) crisp with delicate blue-violet shadow folds and textured surface relief so detail never blows into flat white paper.

name: Low-Key Velvet Darkness With Readable Form
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Preserve deep rich shadow mood while tracing delicate grazing rimlight along shoulders, wool fibers, and table rims so forms separate effortlessly from dark slate backgrounds.

name: Authentic Backlit Signage & Background Depth
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Place illuminated street signage comfortably inside natural background `f/2.0` bokeh falloff rather than demanding razor readability on tiny distant signs so glowing neon feels organic and legible.
